audience: Egyptian business owners, factory and department managers who judge a partner by clarity, seriousness and craft
promise: Pixel Plus builds smart systems and trains teams so daily department work runs without manual friction — proven for a year inside Samsung Electronics Egypt
cta: ابدأ معنا — start with Pixel Plus (no contact details supplied, none shown)
direction: Light, classy Arabic presentation. One hero: the logo's blue pixel travels through nine chapters and builds the logo. El Messiri (+ Instrument Serif italic for Latin) display, IBM Plex Sans Arabic text. Keyword slams behind the action, captions line by line, cursor-driven app windows, one real-3D chapter (TV + phone). Original 80 BPM piano/harp/strings score at −18 LUFS.

creative.viewer: a manager deciding whether Pixel Plus can fix the daily friction in their departments
creative.problem: agencies sell tools and promises; this must look serious, show real work types and stay elegant
creative.promise: smart systems + trained teams that remove daily manual work
creative.evidence: one year of training, projects and system implementation inside Samsung Electronics Egypt (TV and Mobile factories), owner-stated; the film itself as craft proof; no invented clients or numbers
creative.motif: one blue pixel (the logo's i-dot) that orders chaos and finally becomes the logo
creative.light: warm paper white with soft top light, gentle contact shadows, one bright 3D studio
creative.camera: calm locked frames with slow push-ins; one orbiting 3D camera; dives through objects between chapters
creative.motion: spring morphs with motion blur, words rising from blur, cursor-driven UI, orbiting icons, particle assembly

creative.payoff: the pixel bursts into 1,699 pixels that build the Pixel Plus logo; «أنظمة ذكية… لشغل حقيقي»; «ابدأ معنا»
